In the [[Shara]]n culture the '''Abrishi''' seem to be wise men, that know the prophecies regarding the [[Last Battle]]. One of them, called [[Mintel]], adopted [[Demandred]], who called himself Bao while in Shara, because he was fulfilling the Sharans prophecies about the last days. In particular Mintel seems also to be a [[dreamwalker]].
